scope_note: These two bounded UI journeys exercise the governed emulator target. They are not all GOAT E2E tests or product qualification.

preconditions: Use only the dedicated admitted test emulator. GOAT must have no existing local farm, with the first-run introduction visible. If a farm or sign-in form exists, stop; do not clear it.
steps: Open the installed GOAT app and inspect its first-run introduction.
Tap Continue and inspect the setup form, scrolling as necessary. Leave all fields empty and do not submit Create farm.

assertions.description: The actual introduction displays 'Your farm, on this device first' and a reachable Continue action.
Continue opens 'Set up this farm', with Farm name, Your name, Owner username, Owner PIN (6 to 12 digits), and Confirm PIN fields.
The setup form identifies on-device storage and does not demand a server email/password or Google sign-in before local setup.
With the fields empty, Create farm is disabled; no farm is submitted during this inspection.

preconditions: An operator has already opened the synthetic farm named 'GOAT Artemis Qualification' as its local owner/manager. Its management farm home is visible. Stop if that exact test farm or role cannot be established; do not log into another farm.
steps: Inspect the management home and its Home, Animals, Tasks and Records controls.
Open Animals, verify the species chooser, and return to the same farm home.
Open Tasks, then return to the same farm home. Open Records, then return to the same farm home.
Inspect the Theme control's separate lower-right placement without changing any farm or theme setting.

assertions.description: The management home belongs to the exact synthetic farm GOAT Artemis Qualification.
Home, Animals, Tasks and Records labels are complete, readable, separate and reachable at the current device size and font scale.
Animals opens the species chooser, including goat, rabbit, poultry, sheep and cattle, and navigation returns to the same farm home.
Tasks and Records each open their corresponding rendered content, with a working return to the same farm home and no duplicate action.
Theme remains a separate lower-right control on the farm home; no credentials, farm records or settings were changed.
